# Abundance
### Does Abundance apply to my opponent’s sites as well?
Yes, they will get the benefit as well, if your Abundance affects their sites!
### When do I get this extra mana?
The extra Mana is provided immediately, as soon as the site is affected by the aura. The extra mana is lost immediately if the aura stops affecting that site.
### How much mana is generated by playing an Ordinary Tower (e.g. Lone Tower) into Abundance's effect?
3 mana, because 1 (a site entering the realm under your control) + 1 (Abundance) + 1 (Genesis effect) = 3.
